items.headline: Price move coincides with 1 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 5294.12/MWh on 2026-06-08, same day as: YERMARUS TPP unit 1: 800.0 MW affected (~800 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
